description: Dashboard operativo de QoE real respaldado por qoe_real_metrics y qoe_probe_run.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -6h, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe_real_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "upload_speed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.probe_id =~ /^${probe_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.service =~ /^${service:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: r.service, _value: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

spec.description: Ultima velocidad de subida reportada por cada medicion QoE real del servicio seleccionado.
spec.title: Upload real por servicio

spec.query:
allProbes = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe_probe_run")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "run_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.environment =~ /^${environment:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site =~ /^${site:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["probe_id"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _field: r.probe_id, _value: 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

activeProbes = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe_probe_run")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "run_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.environment =~ /^${environment:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site =~ /^${site:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["probe_id"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _field: r.probe_id, _value: 1.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

union(tables: [allProbes, activeProbes])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _field: r._field, _value: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

spec.description: Estado actual de cada sonda QoE real. ON indica que hubo una corrida del probe en los ultimos 10 minutos.
spec.title: Estado de sondas QoE

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe_real_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "available")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.probe_id =~ /^${probe_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.service =~ /^${service:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _field: r.service, _value: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

spec.description: Porcentaje de mediciones reales disponibles por servicio dentro del rango de tiempo seleccionado.
spec.title: Disponibilidad real por servicio

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -4h, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe_real_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.probe_id =~ /^${probe_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.service =~ /^${service:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /available|download_speed|upload_speed|latency|jitter|tool|source_host|error_class|endpoint_name/)
  |> group(columns: ["probe_id", "service", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> toString()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["probe_id", "service"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.endpoint_name =~ /^${endpoint_name:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      "Sonda": r.probe_id,
      "Servicio": r.service,
      "Endpoint": if exists r.endpoint_name then r.endpoint_name else "",
      "Estado": if exists r.available and r.available == "true" then "Disponible" else "Caido",
      "Download Mbps": if exists r.download_speed then r.download_speed else "0",
      "Upload Mbps": if exists r.upload_speed then r.upload_speed else "0",
      "Latencia ms": if exists r.latency then r.latency else "0",
      "Jitter ms": if exists r.jitter then r.jitter else "0",
      "Herramienta": if exists r.tool then r.tool else "",
      "Host": if exists r.source_host then r.source_host else "",
      "Error": if exists r.error_class then r.error_class else ""
    }))
  |> keep(columns: ["Sonda", "Servicio", "Endpoint", "Estado", "Download Mbps", "Upload Mbps", "Latencia ms", "Jitter ms", "Herramienta", "Host", "Error"])
  |> sort(columns: ["Sonda", "Servicio", "Endpoint"])

rest.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoe_http_check")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "available")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.environment =~ /^${environment:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site =~ /^${site:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["probe_id", "service"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      probe_id: r.probe_id,
      service: r.service,
      "Disponibilidad %": r._value * 100.0
    }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["probe_id", "service"])
